title: Review old branches: merge what's needed, prune the rest
description:

title: Repair failing dotfile hooks and MCP startup configuration

comments.author: Ivan Cherniukh
comments.text: 2026-08-18: Updated hk Pkl imports from 1.48.0 to 1.51.0 and replaced the incompatible ShellCheck builtin override with an explicit scoped step. Applied only ~/.config/hk/config.pkl via chezmoi. Verified hk validate, hk pre-commit, isolated secret scan, and apply guard pass. Mureka was crashing with unpinned MCP 2.x; registered a tested uvx launch with mcp<2, httpx, mureka-mcp==0.0.13, 30s startup and 300s tool timeouts. Fresh initialize handshakes pass for Mureka, Claude, Brave, Exa, MarkItDown, PDF Reader, Read Website Fast, Repomix, and Sequential Thinking. title: Fix slow zsh typing and completion regression
description: Typing/autocompletion became slow after recent dotfiles updates. Inspect zsh plugin ownership, history options, and live interactive behavior; restore documented fast completion setup.
close_reason: Restored zsh-autocomplete by removing unsupported async disable; throttled with documented min-input/delay/list-lines settings and verified Tab completion in fresh PTY.

title: Clean up chezmoi migration gaps
description: Fix omissions from the recent stow-to-chezmoi migration: stale docs, ignored secret path, old hardcoded stow paths, broken migrated symlinks, and accidental generated/scratch files.
close_reason: Fixed chezmoi migration gaps, applied source to live home files, and verified source/live state.

title: Audit Karabiner config and migrate generic remaps out of raw JSON
description: Review the current Karabiner setup and reduce raw karabiner.json maintenance. Produce a rule-by-rule split across: Keep in Karabiner GUI, Move to Kanata, Move to app settings or automation, Delete. Prioritize moving generic keyboard semantics such as Hyper Caps, right_cmd navigation, right_cmd+space, and similar non-Apple-specific logic into a simpler authoring format or Kanata. Keep Apple-specific function-key, fn/globe, and device-specific behavior in Karabiner unless there is a clearly better owner. Clean up dead or experimental rules along the way.

title: Fix tmux which-key and compact host-aware status
description: On this VPS, tmux-which-key is configured but not installed, leaving prefix-Space bound to next-layout. Compact the status line: show current window as [sN], omit tab numbers when names exist, remove the clock, and show a small hostname-hash color cell. Install and verify the configured plugin on the VPS without touching unrelated worktree changes.
acceptance_criteria: prefix-Space and Alt-Space invoke which-key; status-left shows [sN]; named tabs omit numeric prefixes; status-right has no clock and contains a deterministic hostname-colored cell; config parses under tmux 3.5a.
close_reason: Raised the hostname-derived marker saturation from 65% to 70%, applied it through chezmoi, and verified live and isolated tmux state.

title: Migrate hk configs to the 2.x pkl schema, unpin hk
description:
mise had hk = "latest", which moved to 2.0.1 (installed 2026-09-15). In 2.x the pkl schema turned hooks/steps from Mappings into Listings, so both ~/proj/dotfiles/hk.pkl and dot_config/hk/config.pkl (global, merged into every repo) failed with 'Eval error: listing index amendment requires an Int index'. Every pre-commit hook on the machine errored out.

Stopgap on 2026-09-22: pinned hk = "1.51.0" in dot_config/mise/config.toml (commit fe87de7). mise says 1.51.0 is 'pruned in 24h', so the pin needs mise to keep it, or the migration needs doing.

To do: read the hk 2.x docs/migration notes, rewrite both configs to the new schema, bump the amends/import URLs to 2.x, verify with 'hk validate' in dotfiles and one other repo, then set hk back to latest.

title: Plan dotfiles migration to mise and bun without Homebrew-installed mise

comments.author: Ivan Cherniukh
comments.text: Cleanup pass on 2026-06-16: tracked ~/.config/mise/config.toml in dotfiles with bun/node/python/ruby/rust/uv; removed direct fnm, pyenv, Bun ~/.bun, Homebrew Ruby, and Cargo env startup wiring from active zsh/profile files; kept a narrow CARGO_HOME/bin PATH line after mise activation because mise Rust delegates to rustup shims; installed rust stable via mise/rustup; migrated pipx tools claude-monitor, mido, and toolong to uv tool and uninstalled their pipx venvs; removed unmanaged ~/.scripts/bsx and stale bsx shell cache block. Fresh zsh verifies node/python/ruby/bun/uv from mise and rustc/cargo from rustup shims under mise RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN. Remaining decision: whether to uninstall now-unused Homebrew packages such as fnm, node, pyenv, pipx, poetry, ruby, uv, pnpm, stow, and possibly zsh plugin formulae after confirming no other workflows need them.

comments.author: Ivan Cherniukh
comments.text: Follow-up on 2026-06-16: full chezmoi apply required --force because ~/.zprofile had changed since chezmoi last wrote it; applied successfully. Quick-terminal colorls failure was reproduced in a clean login zsh after Homebrew Ruby gem PATH cleanup. Fixed by declaring "gem:colorls" = "latest" in tracked ~/.config/mise/config.toml and installing it via mise gem backend; mise current now activates gem:colorls 1.5.0.

comments.author: Ivan Cherniukh
comments.text: Follow-up on 2026-06-16: npx issue traced to stale user npm config prefix=/Users/ivan/.npm-global from pre-mise Node. Removed it with npm config delete prefix --location=user. Clean login zsh now resolves node/npm/npx from mise node@24 and npm global prefix to ~/.local/share/mise/installs/node/24.

comments.author: Ivan Cherniukh
comments.text: Correction/follow-up on 2026-06-16: npm prefix cleanup had two layers. Removed ~/.npmrc prefix=/Users/ivan/.npm-global, then found mise node@24.11.0 was a symlink to ~/.nvm/versions/node/v24.11.0, so clean shells still inherited an nvm npm prefix. Fixed with mise install --force node@24.11.0, which replaced the symlink with a real mise-owned Node install. Clean login zsh now resolves node/npm/npx from ~/.local/share/mise/installs/node/24 and npm prefix/root to ~/.local/share/mise/installs/node/24.11.0. Note: replacing the old nvm-backed tree removed previous global npm CLI symlinks from the mise node bin; reinstall intentionally needed CLIs via mise npm backend or npm install -g under mise.

comments.author: Ivan Cherniukh

Linked it from README.md.

title: Auto-invoke beads-slim when bd is set up in a new project
description: Currently beads-slim (dot_scripts/executable_beads-slim) has to be run manually against a repo after bd init/bd setup. Idea from a falai session: teach agents (via global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md or the beads skill) to run beads-slim automatically whenever they initialize bd in a project, so new projects get the trimmed PRIME.md + tuned hooks without a manual step. No code needed beyond the existing script -- this is a global-instructions change, not new tooling. Deferred because it touches ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (global, affects every project) and needs its own consideration separate from the beads-slim script itself.
